landing.title: Grow what will sell. Sell to whoever needs it.
landing.subtitle: AgriDirect looks at mandi arrivals, prices, rainfall and soil in your district and suggests which crops are likely to fetch a fair price this season. When your crop is ready, companies looking for it can find you and make an offer directly.
landing.priceNote: Modal price. Arrow shows the change over the last four weeks.

advice.title: Check before you sow
advice.body: Enter your district, land and water source. You get three to five crops ranked for this season, with the reason for each.

list.title: List your harvest early
list.body: Add the crop, quantity and the date it will be ready. Buyers within 200 km can see it straight away.

deal.title: Agree a price directly
deal.body: Buyers send offers. You can accept, reject or ask for a better price, and every step is recorded.

system.title: Data and model health
system.subtitle: Daily ingestion runs at 02:00 IST. Failed runs are shown in red.
system.modelHint: Hold-out results against the seasonal-naive baseline. Lower MAPE and higher F1 are better.

what.title: What we collect
what.body: Your mobile number, name, village and district, farm or unit location, land and crop details, and for companies the GSTIN and contact person. We do not collect Aadhaar, bank details or date of birth.

why.title: Why
why.body: Your phone number is used to log in and for deal communication. Your location is used only for crop advice and to match you with nearby buyers or sellers.

shared.title: Who sees it
shared.body: Companies see your village and an approximate distance, never your exact location. Phone numbers are shown to the other party only after a deal is accepted.

retention.title: How long we keep it
retention.body: Inactive accounts are notified after 24 months and then deleted. Deleted accounts are purged within 30 days; deal records are kept only in anonymised form.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: You can view, correct or delete your data, withdraw consent at any time from Settings, and nominate someone to act for you.

grievance.title: Grievance contact
grievance.body: Contact details of the grievance officer will be published here before launch.
